div.head: Af El. 19
div.ab: Gif hwa oþrum hys eage ofdo, sylle his agen fore: toþ for toþ, handa wiþ handa, fett for fett, bærning for bærninge, wund wið wunde, læl wið læle.
Gif hwa oðrum his eage oðdo, selle his agen fore: toð fore teð, honda wið honda, fet fore fét, bærning for bærninge, wund wið wunde, læl wið læle.
oculum pro oculo, dentem pro dente, manum pro manu, pedem pro pede, adustionem pro adustione, uulnus pro uulnere, liuorem pro liuore.
Gif hwa oðrum his eage oðdo, selle his agen fore: toð fore teð, honda wið honda, fet fore fet, bærning for bærninge, wund wið wunde, læl wið læle.
If someone should put out another’s eye, let him give his own for it: tooth for tooth, hand for hand, feet for feet, burning for burning, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.
Wenn jemand einem anderen sein Auge ausstösst, gebe er sein eigenes [Auge] dafür: Zahn für Zahn, Hände gegen Hände, Füsse für Füsse, Brandmal für Brandmal, Wunde gegen Wunde, Strieme gegen Strieme.
If someone puts out another’s eye, let him give his own [eye] for it: tooth for tooth, hands for hands, feet for feet, burn for burn, wound for wound, weal for weal.
